description: Genome skimming or whole-genome sequencing reads, Illumina single-end
message: Single-end reads are not tested in 0.5.0: give the two FASTQ files of a paired Illumina run.
Target capture is not admitted in 0.5.0: its off-target reads did not hold the plastid loci of the library (2 of 5 and 0 of 5 in the capture test of 28-09).
Long reads are not admitted in 0.5.0 (59 experiments of 13 species of Cactaceae, 2 with a voucher).
Aligned reads are not admitted in 0.5.0: convert them to FASTQ first (samtools fastq) and give the two files as reads_paired.
RAD-seq and GBS reads are fragments next to restriction sites, not the loci of the library: rejected.
RNA-seq reads measure expression, not presence, and lack the non-coding loci of the library: rejected.
A mixture of amplicons is a mixture of species, another problem than identifying a specimen: rejected.
Chromatograms need base calling first, outside PhyloCactus: give the FASTA of the called sequence as sanger.

description: Nuclear fraction of genome skims (Strategy B, Skmer)
message: The nuclear fraction of genome skims (Skmer) is out of 0.5.0: give the reads as reads_paired, identified through plastome and nrDNA.
